visualCharacteristics: Two-column intro row on a light/secondary background. Left column holds a large heading, a subheading, and two CTA buttons; right column holds a stacked group of three cover images.
contentPattern: Single row, two cells. Cell 1: heading + subheading + button group. Cell 2: three images.
usage: Use at the top of a page as a hero-style intro that pairs a text call-to-action with a cluster of supporting images.
